rubric_hint.rule: 2 eligible species recorded beyond 250 m but within 1000 m, none within 250 m
rubric_hint.basis: prompts/rubric.md v1 applied to all rings 0-1000 m and effort; a default, not a verdict

reasons.claim: Notified 5.08 ha regeneration felling in Eksjö, status notified. Completed felling overlaps only 0.269 ha (5.3%), from 2003 and 2009, so it is not already felled.
No species records inside the polygon or within 250 m, so no eligible species within 250 m.

Two eligible species lie beyond 250 m but within 1000 m. Sclerophora pallida (VU lichen) is 402 m away (2023, uncertainty 100 m); its threats include lack of continuity forest and of large or old trees. Goodyera repens (VU vascular plant) has 9 records, nearest 556 m (2024, uncertainty 25 m); its threats include lack of dead wood and increased openness. This triggers MEDIUM.

Supporting context: site-bound forest NT species such as Crossocalyx hellerianus (593 m) and Porodaedalea pini (681 m) lie beyond 250 m, so the NT trigger is not met. Mobile NT birds and bats are supporting evidence only.

Effort is adequate: 152 records and 101 species within 1000 m against a county median of 58.5 (71st percentile). Near-site, however, there are zero records inside the polygon or within 250 m (county median within 250 m is 1).

contradictions.claim: Effort within 1000 m is above the county median, yet no records exist within 250 m. The empty near-site ring reflects little recording at the site, so it should not be read as absence of species.

uncertainties: The nearest eligible record is 402 m away with 100 m uncertainty and says little about the notified stand.
No near-site records exist, so the stand is effectively unsurveyed in public data.
All records come from Artportalen. They show a species was recorded, not that it occupies the site today.
not_established: That Sclerophora pallida, Goodyera repens or any threatened species occurs on the notified stand.
Absence of species inside the polygon.
That the site is safe to fell, or any legal status of the species.
next_action: Ask a reviewer to check the 2023 Sclerophora pallida record (GBIF 6542724405) and the 2024 Goodyera repens records (e.g. GBIF 5130831268) against the polygon, and consider a field check of the stand because no near-site records exist.
